content: हत {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} [हन्-क्त] .²1 Killed, slain; सुषेणं च हतोऽसीति ब्रुवन्नादत्त सायकम् <ls>Mb. 8. 48. 31</ls>. .²2 Hurt, struck, injured; चक्षुरादिषु हताः स्वार्थावबोधक्रियाः <ls>Mu. 3. 1</ls>. .²3 Lost, perished; शमं न लेभे हृदयज्वरार्दितो नरर्षभो यूथहतो यथर्षभः <ls>Rām. 2. 85. 21</ls>. .²4 Deprived or bereft of. .²5 Disappointed, frustrated; वयं तत्त्वान्वेषात् हताः <ls>Ś. 1. 23</ls>. .²6 Impeded, obstructed. .²7 Utterly ruined, extinguished, destroyed. .²8 Multiplied. .²9 Whirled up, raised. .²10 Suffering from. .²11 Violated (sexually). .²12 Miserable, wretched. .²13 Defective. See हन्. It is often used as the first member of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘wretched’, ‘miserable’, ‘accursed’, ‘worthless’; अनुशयदुःखायेदं हतहृदयं संप्रति विवुद्धम् <ls>Ś. 6. 6</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 28</ls>; कुर्यामुपेक्षां हतजीवितेऽस्मिन् <ls>R. 14. 65</ls>; हतविधिलसितानां ही विचित्रो विपाकः <ls>Śi. 11. 64</ls>. .{@-तम्@} .²1 Killing, striking. .²2 Multiplication. .{@-ता@} .²1 A violated woman. .²2 A despised girl (unfit for marriage).
